title: Water and Power Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Water and Power Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2000
WATER AND POWER
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2000
An
Ordinance further to amend the Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th July, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
17-7-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called Water and Power
Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000:
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
